text: Summarize the MTP correction and output-head correction for this project: MTP predicts n+2 from end of n+1 pass (no mid-token early guess for n+1, at best prefetch n+2 during n+1), and the 509M head costs ~1GB BF16 / 250MB INT4 RAM read per token. State operational consequences: quarantine next-token branch, quantize head, measure CM4 RAM bandwidth before tok/s claims. 600+ words.
